query: 2026 Venezuela earthquakes June 24 confirmed death toll latest figures, trajectory of confirmed deaths reported by authorities and Wikipedia, number of missing persons and rescue operation status
answer:
I've completed the research on the June 24, 2026 Venezuela earthquakes. Here's a summary of the key findings:

## Summary

**Event:** Twin earthquakes (Mw 7.2 foreshock + Mw 7.5 mainshock, 39 seconds apart) struck near Veroes Municipality, Yaracuy on June 24, 2026 at 18:04 VET. La Guaira state was worst hit (80% of buildings collapsed).

**Confirmed death toll trajectory** (steady climb over ~1 month):
- Jun 24: ~164 → Jun 29: 1,719 → Jul 6: 3,535 → Jul 16: ~5,000 → Jul 21: 5,278 → **latest (~Jul 25, Wikipedia): more than 5,500 (~5,546)**
- Injured: ~16,700–16,740
- USGS PAGER projected the toll could ultimately exceed 10,000

**Missing persons:**
- **No official government figure** has been published by the interim Rodríguez government
- UN estimate: **40,000–50,000 missing**
- Crowdsourced databases range from 18,100 to 41,301

**Rescue operations:**
- Peaked at 2,000–2,400 foreign rescuers from ~27–30 countries + up to ~31,800 Venezuelan personnel and ~30,500 volunteers, coordinated by UN OCHA
- >6,400 rescued by ~July 1; notable rescues include a 3-year-old (6 days), Hernán Gil (8 days), and two people found alive July 23 (nearly a month later)
- Hampered by 500–600+ aftershocks; by mid-July operations shifted from rescue to recovery/rebuilding

The most notable data-integrity point for forecasting: **Wikipedia and authorities report the same climbing confirmed-death figure (>5,500), but the missing-persons count remains officially withheld**, with only UN and civil-society estimates available — creating a wide gap (18,100–50,000) between confirmed deaths and potential unaccounted-for victims. Full details, sources, and the day-by-day data table have been captured in the structured output.

key_facts: Two earthquakes (Mw 7.2 foreshock + Mw 7.5 mainshock, 39 seconds apart) struck Venezuela on 24 June 2026 at 18:04 VET; epicenters in Veroes Municipality, Yaracuy.
Confirmed death toll rose steadily: ~164 (Jun 24) -> 1,719 (Jun 29) -> 3,535 (Jul 6) -> ~5,000 (Jul 16) -> 5,278 (Jul 21) -> more than 5,500 (~5,546) as of late July 2026 per Wikipedia.
Injured figure reached approximately 16,700-16,740 as of mid-to-late July 2026.
No official government figure for missing persons has been published; the interim Rodriguez government has withheld it.
UN estimated 40,000-50,000 people missing (USG Tom Fletcher, Jun 27); crowdsourced databases range from 18,100 to 41,301.
USGS PAGER system projected the eventual death toll could exceed 10,000.
More than 6,400 people were rescued by ~July 1; an additional ~13,400 self-rescued in Caraballeda/Catia La Mar.
Peak rescue effort involved 2,000-2,400 foreign rescuers from ~27-30 countries, 160+ dogs, and up to ~31,800 Venezuelan government personnel plus ~30,500 volunteers, coordinated by UN OCHA.
Notable survivor rescues included a 3-year-old after 6 days, security guard Hernan Gil after 8 days (Jul 2), and two people found alive on July 23 (nearly a month later).
La Guaira state was hardest hit with 80% of buildings collapsed; 500-600+ aftershocks (including M5.2) complicated rescue efforts.
By mid-July operations shifted from rescue to recovery and rebuilding; 10,000 body bags were procured and >2,200 bodies buried by July 6.
Over 200 foreign nationals confirmed dead, including citizens of Portugal (~100), France (~45), Spain (~40), Colombia (~24), and Italy (~16).
